groups.Title: File backup jobs
groups.Detail: Example launcher: replace File Explorer with your preferred backup tool.

items.Title: Backup notes
items.Detail: Open Notepad to record the settings and files you want to preserve.

items.Title: Documents
items.Detail: Open your Documents folder and back up the files you need.

items.Title: 1. Internal backup
items.Detail: Run your internal-drive backup job and review its results.

items.Title: 2. External backup
items.Detail: Connect your backup drive, run its backup job, and review the results.

items.Title: 3. Application settings backup
items.Detail: Back up your selected application settings and review the results.
